tools.name: diagnostics_info
tools.description: Read server identity, canonical log path, retention and recording health. No payloads.

tools.name: diagnostics_tools
tools.description: List contracts from the active server registrations. No domain data.

tools.name: diagnostics_append
tools.description: Retain one app observation in bounded memory and persist its metadata only. App-origin observations remain claims.

tools.name: diagnostics_events
tools.description: Read at most 20 recent server event summaries. Payloads excluded; inspection never repeats an action.

tools.name: diagnostics_event
tools.description: Read one frozen, masked, bounded diagnostic event. Expired payloads are unavailable.

tools.name: diagnostics_capture
tools.description: Save diagnostic capture: explicitly persist the retained masked payloads for one selected interaction. No source reread or replay.

tools.name: canvas_diagnostics
tools.description: Read recent connection metadata and the local log path. Includes server identity, repository opens, and binding lifecycle; excludes source, drafts, and chat content.

tools.name: canvas_open
tools.title: Repo Canvas
tools.description: Open the repository architecture workbench inside this conversation. The side chat sends user messages directly to this chat, and canvas_reply returns responses and reviewed proposals.

repo.description: Absolute target repository path. Omit to resolve the calling chat workspace, with the picker as fallback.

tools.name: canvas_app
tools.description: App-only map, source, draft and discussion operations for the hosted Repo Canvas UI.

tools.name: canvas_requests
tools.description: List request IDs, questions and status for one canvas, or discover active canvases. No map, source content or history bodies.

tools.name: canvas_request
tools.description: Read a compact summary of one explicitly submitted canvas request. No complete map, source metadata or history. The user message usually already contains this summary.

tools.name: canvas_map
tools.description: Read the exact frozen architecture document for one request when map inspection or a complete map proposal needs it. No discussion history or source file contents.

tools.name: canvas_comments
tools.description: Page summaries of contextual notes explicitly attached to one request. Maximum 10 notes with 400-character excerpts. Use canvas_comment_text for the exact note or excerpt; no map or history.

tools.name: canvas_comment_text
tools.description: Read one exact text field of an attached contextual note in 4000-character chunks. No map, other notes or provenance.

tools.name: canvas_provenance
tools.description: Read source references for one selected module or attached note in an exact request, only when source verification is needed. No file contents.

tools.name: canvas_snapshot
tools.description: Read the latest panel-reported semantic state: scope, multi-selection, viewport, panels, draft/conflict, command result and freshness. Include the document before proposing edits. DOM, dialogs and pixels are available through browser tools, not this semantic snapshot.

tools.name: canvas_command
tools.description: Queue one reversible view command against an exact snapshot revision. Does not edit or save the map. Read canvas_snapshot again to check applied/rejected status; queuing is not completion.

tools.name: canvas_propose
tools.description: Offer a complete map against an exact live snapshot revision, without requiring a side-chat request. Preserves the current draft; the user reviews, applies to draft and saves. Stale proposals cannot apply.

tools.name: canvas_reply
tools.description: Return this conversation’s answer to a specific pending canvas request. Optionally propose a complete architecture document; it is validated and reviewed in the canvas before applying. Never runs an LLM or writes repository files.

proposal.description: Optional complete version-3 architecture document with title, modules, connections and annotations. Read the request first to preserve its layout and notes.

resources.name: Repo Canvas workbench
resources.description: Hierarchical repository architecture with side chat in the current conversation.

tools.name: usage_open
tools.title: Usage dashboard
tools.description: Open local Codex usage in an MCP App. Optional absolute log roots; defaults to Codex sessions and archived sessions.

tools.name: trace_open
tools.title: Trace analyzer
tools.description: Open a recorded Codex session and indexed child sessions in an MCP App. Requires a session ID; optional absolute log roots.

tools.name: report_app
tools.description: Read or refresh one report context, load pinned record bodies, or freeze an explicit discussion selection. Never writes source logs.

tools.name: usage_summary
tools.description: Read token totals and filters for one explicitly attached frozen usage selection. No source metadata or transcript. Use only when the message summary is insufficient.

tools.name: usage_records
tools.description: Page exact token-usage entries from an attached usage selection. These are accounting entries, not messages or tool calls. No provenance. Maximum 20 entries per page.

tools.name: trace_events
tools.description: Page short action/message previews within an explicitly attached frozen turn or action. No source paths or hashes. Maximum 20 events per page.

tools.name: trace_event_text
tools.description: Read one field of one event inside an attached trace selection. Returns a bounded text chunk and nextOffset; source bytes must still match the frozen revision.

tools.name: report_provenance
tools.description: Inspect source identity and coverage only when provenance is needed. Requires an explicitly attached selection. Pages at most 20 contributing sources; does not read source bodies.

tools.name: example_open
tools.title: Example MCP App
tools.description: Open the developer playground for inspecting MCP App tools, resources, bridge messages and lifecycle.

tools.name: example_echo
tools.description: Echo a bounded demo payload, or deliberately return a tool error. No files or external services are used.

tools.name: example_trace
tools.description: App-only graph snapshot. Conversation investigations use example_status, example_events and example_event for scoped reads. App reports never prove model delivery.

tools.name: example_report
tools.description: Store a bounded self-reported trace from this app panel. Diagnostic only; never proves host or model behavior.

tools.name: example_status
tools.description: Read the active build and panel identities without event payloads. Ordinary messages need no diagnostic read.

tools.name: example_events
tools.description: List at most 20 retained event summaries from the server or one explicit panel. Filter by run ID when known; no payloads.

tools.name: example_event
tools.description: Read one exact frozen event payload by its source-local sequence and optional panel ID. App reports remain self-reported evidence.

tools.name: diagnostics_info
tools.description: Read build, canonical log location, recording health and retention. No event payloads.

tools.name: diagnostics_tools
tools.description: Read the tool catalog generated from this bundled server during build.

tools.name: diagnostics_capture
tools.description: Save diagnostic capture for one selected live interaction. Only currently retained masked observations are saved; no action is replayed.
